    solver = z3.Solver()

    N = 25

        model = solver.model()
        grid = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
        for num in range(N):
            for i in range(n):
                for j in range(n):
                    if z3.is_true(model.evaluate(x[num][i][j])):
                        grid[i][j] = num + 1
        return True, grid
    return False, None
